chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: You will never be able to please all people with your wealth, so please them with your good character.

key_terms.أخلاق: Character, manners, moral conduct -- a comprehensive term encompassing all aspects of ethical behavior

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about pleasing people with good character instead of wealth?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) taught that since material resources are always limited and cannot satisfy everyone, believers should instead win people over through noble character and good manners. This was spoken to his companions during a time when generosity and hospitality were highly valued social virtues in Arabian culture, and the Prophet redirected this value toward the more universally accessible virtue of good conduct.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf narrated to us from Muhammad b. Sinan from Ghiyath b. Ibrahim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: You do not please the people with your wealth, so please them with your character.
